title: THE ELYSIAN.
metaDescription: The Elysian Band — a continuous circle of the Elysian Cut™, Bez Ambar's elongated oval-baguette hybrid. Full eternity and halfway versions. Made in Los Angeles.
copy: Most bands alternate: stone, metal, stone. The Elysian Cut™ was drawn to remove the interruption — an elongated form, part oval, part baguette, that meets its neighbor edge to edge so light travels the finger in one unbroken line. Set in a full circle, it reads less like a row of diamonds than a single band of light. The name states the intent: the Elysian — a place made entirely of light.

specs.label: Gem Stone
specs.body: Elysian Cut™ diamonds — Bez Ambar's elongated oval-baguette hybrid, set edge to edge. White VVS; G-H color VVS on the largest size.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Full eternity and halfway versions in four stone sizes. Also available: The Elysian Bracelet. Designed and made in Los Angeles — by private appointment.
